_note: Draft translations of the S3 local-voice strings (ui.chat.voice.local_*, download_notice*, ui.settings.voice.local_note). NOT shipped: i18n/ledger.json requires an independent audit receipt per locale file (scripts/i18n/ledger-check.mjs), and check-i18n fails closed on an unaudited file. Audit, then move each block into src/i18n/catalogues/<locale>/ui.chat.voice.json and ui.settings.voice.json and add ledger entries.
